title: Yamaguchi-kun Isn't So Bad
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shy Satsuki Shinohara's high-school debut is nearly ruined by a pervert on the train until she is rescued by Yamaguchi-kun, a classmate everyone thinks is a gangster. She sets out to show that he is kinder than his scary reputation, and a sweet romance between classmates follows (Kodansha USA blurb; MU categories).
life_message: Look past appearances and reputations to see a person's real kindness.

content.note: Rescue from a train pervert; 'gangster' reputation (Kodansha blurb). No fighting described (to verify).
Innocent love between high-school classmates (MU Innocent Love, Student-Student Relationship); train harassment incident at start.
